title: Qinhuangdao VTS (秦皇岛港)
authority: Hebei MSA, Qinhuangdao MSA (秦皇岛海事局) VTS centre
applies_to: Ships in Qinhuangdao port waters, anchorages and waiting areas (no published VTS rules found).
applies_quote: 相关船舶应遵守船舶交通管理规定及港前待泊区相关管理制度，服从VTS中心交通组织、指挥。（冀航通〔2025〕0286号）

when.text: Ships in the waiting areas (港前待泊区) must follow the ship traffic management rules and obey the traffic organisation and orders of the VTS centre. (冀航通〔2025〕0286号, 三.1)

No local VTS rules with report points were found. Expect the usual Chinese VTS reports: on reaching the VTS area, before entering or leaving the channel, before weighing anchor, after anchoring, before unberthing and after berthing. (Inferred, not printed in a Qinhuangdao source.)

ports: Qinhuangdao (秦皇岛港), incl. East port and Shanhaiguan waiting areas, Hebei

sources.title: 关于公布新选划秦皇岛港港前待泊区的通告 冀航通〔2025〕0286号
Hebei MSA site: 2026年秦皇岛海事局VTS中心社会满意度调查问卷 (shows the VTS centre exists)

verification: Searched msa.gov.cn (title and full text) and hb.msa.gov.cn site search for Qinhuangdao VTS rules, channels and report lines; found only the 2025 waiting area notice and the VTS centre survey.
notes: GAP: no official Qinhuangdao VTS channel, call sign, area, report lines or phone found; ask the agent or call on VHF16. Waiting areas since 2025-09-21: East port 1# to 8# (bulk carriers in ballast, 100,000 t and below) and Shanhaiguan 1# and 2# (up to 300,000 t, max draught 10.0 m and 11.0 m); the old 1# to 3# waiting areas are closed. The port closes to traffic in strong wind (traffic control notices on hb.msa.gov.cn, e.g. wind 7 or more).
